# File `bootstrap.sh`

Configure a fresh clone to enforce the repository's local policy.

This script is intentionally idempotent so it can be rerun after Git or hook changes. It installs no global settings: every Git configuration write is scoped to the current repository, leaving the developer's other clones alone.
